proves.claim: With landing.parallelGates on, two gated groups gated against the same main update trunk one after the other through the compare-and-swap push.

cli.journeys-land-parallel-push.two-gate.why: Without it, parallel groups could overwrite one another on trunk and nobody would notice.

proves.claim: A group whose push loses the compare-and-swap to the other group retries on the new tip and lands.

cli.journeys-land-parallel-push.a-group-.why: Without it, a group that lost the swap could be dropped or land on a stale base.

proves.claim: Each recorded landing names the main commit it was gated against, and the landed merge sits on exactly that commit.

cli.journeys-land-parallel-push.each-lan.why: Without it, a landing could record a main other than the one its tree was checked on.
